decision.observation: 7:20 am Thu 4; the farmer stands at the Stardrop Saloon's front door beside a lamppost; the saloon is closed (morning). The paved plaza lies west, bushes below-right.
decision.hypothesis: In the morning villagers walk around town; heading north-east toward the mountain road (Robin/Demetrius/Maru's house) or south to the beach will find more villagers to greet (7/28).
decision.memory: Town plaza → saloon route known; beach south, mountains north-east. 405g; axe selected; full-ish energy.
